notes: Provider adapter only; scheduled/background work must enqueue tickets instead of launching this command directly. Grok natively reads .claude/rules/*.md when its Claude-compat mode is on, independent of this harness's own .grok/rules sync. HOOKS: none, by decision. grok 1.0.40 reported total_hooks=0 with --trust in both the real repo and a clean sandbox -- it discovered neither .grok/hooks/*.json nor the .claude/settings.json compat path -- and chasing it is not worth it: a hook that hangs the agent costs more than the floor it enforces. Grok is covered the same way Codex and OpenCode are: the mandatory first-turn full_boot.sh instruction in AGENTS.md. Do not set supports_hooks true again without a run that shows a pre_tool hook actually firing.
